異常スタンピードは無事終息した。メイズシフターの大部分は巣である\nメイズに戻り: <size=90%>The abnormal stampede was safely brought to an end. Most of the Maze Shifters returned to the Maze, their nest, while the remaining raging individuals were defeated by the academy students.</size>
俺は生徒会室に向かった。\n無論、生徒会長と話をするためだ。: I headed to the Student Council office. Naturally, it was to talk with the Student Council President.
やはり<r=クリスタル・ベルト>煌晶帯</r>に、\nスタンピードを誘発する原因: So there really was a cause triggering the stampede in the Crystal Belt, after all.
ええ……結論からいえば、あなたの想像通り双頭の斧が原因でした。: Yes... To state the conclusion first, the cause was indeed the Double-Headed Axe, just as you imagined.
……さっき交戦したらしい翠蘭達から話を聞いた。: ...I heard about it from Suiran and the others, who apparently engaged them earlier.
双頭の斧は対メイズシフター誘導装置『サイレン』なるものを使用し、\nこれにより人: It seems the Double-Headed Axe used a device called Siren, an anti-Maze Shifter induction unit, to artificially induce the stampede.
カオスメイデンは戦闘の末サイレンの使用を停止させるも破壊には失敗、\n双頭の斧に: After a battle, Chaos Maiden succeeded in stopping the Siren's operation but failed to destroy it, and the Double-Headed Axe managed to escape into the deeper layers of the Maze.
……そっか、それは仕方ないな。\nカオスメイデンのみんなが無事であるほうが大事だ: ...I see. Well, that can't be helped. Everyone in Chaos Maiden being safe is what matters most.
異常スタンピードの終息は、彼女らの活躍の結果、\nサイレンの機能が停止したからだ: The end of the abnormal stampede was likely because the Siren ceased functioning as a result of their efforts.
サイレンに関する詳しい情報は、\n後ほど翠蘭が撮ったという映像とセットで確認する: We'll review the detailed information regarding the Siren later alongside the video footage Suiran reportedly captured—
コトハの目的は、一体なんだ？: What on earth is Kotoha's objective?
翠蘭の話では、ユリアが発見するなり仕掛けたので\n戦闘に発展したそうだ。: According to Suiran, Julia initiated an attack the moment she spotted them, which escalated into combat.
事前に、双頭の斧と接触する可能性は\n伝えていましたからね。警戒していたのでしょ: I had informed them in advance about the possibility of encountering the Double-Headed Axe, after all. They were likely on high alert.
だが、コトハ達は戦闘に消極的だったと聞く。: However, I heard that Kotoha and her group were reluctant to fight.
そもそも思うんだ。あいつは確かに犯罪行為や危険な所業に\n手を染めている。でも本: I've been thinking about this in the first place. She's certainly dabbling in criminal acts and dangerous deeds. But is she truly 'evil' at her core?
実際、今回の異常スタンピード、結果だけ見れば死人は出なかった。\n怪我人は多少出: In fact, looking solely at the result of this abnormal stampede, no one died. There were a few injured, but I heard everyone can return to their daily lives.
コトハは、最初から殺意なんてなかったんじゃないか？: Could it be that Kotoha never had any intent to kill from the very start?
いえ、ただのたとえ話です。\n彼女が仮に悪だとすると、一体何にとっての『悪』なの: No, it is merely a hypothetical example. Supposing she is evil, then to what exactly is she 'evil'?
然るべき時と場で、ちゃんとお話します。: I will tell you properly at the appropriate time and place.
他に翠蘭からは、コトハが『ストリート』と呼ばれる学園内の地域を\n拠点としていた: I also heard from Suiran that she extracted info that Kotoha seems to have used an area within the academy called 'Street' as her base—
では、私はそろそろ失礼します。戦闘後の処理が立て込んでいますので、\n今日はここ: Well then, I shall take my leave soon. Post-battle procedures are piling up, so please let us wrap up for today.
詳細は聞けなそうだ。: Looks like I won't be able to get the details out of her.
ドロテア先輩。\nどうしたんですか、こんなところで。: Dorothea-senpai. What is wrong, being in a place like this?
クラウディアさん……いえ、なんだか気が抜けてしまって。: Claudia-san... No, I just feel like the tension has completely left me.
あの激しい戦いからまだ数日ですから。\n疲れが取れていないのかもしれませんよ。: It has only been a few days since that fierce battle. Your fatigue might not have cleared up yet.
あの……ひとつ聞いても？: Um... May I ask you something?
どうして先輩は、あんな風に戦えたんですか？: Why were you able to fight like that, Senpai?
絶望的な状況だったのは間違いありませんでした。\nでも先輩は誰よりも先に、迷いな: There was no doubt it was a hopeless situation. Yet, before anyone else, you moved without hesitation...
あんな戦いは、先輩だって経験したことのないものだったはず。\nでも迷う様子は見ら: A battle like that must have been something even you had never experienced before, Senpai. Yet I saw no sign of hesitation in you.
私達は先輩にあてられる形で立ち上がれましたが、\nあなたがいなければただ怯えて何: We were able to stand up inspired by you, but had you not been there, we likely would have just been terrified and unable to do anything.
どうして、あんなにもまっすぐ先頭に立ち、\n前だけを向けたのですか？: How were you able to stand straight at the very front and look only forward like that?
なんだ、答えをご存じじゃないですか。: My, so you already knew the answer.
私は漠然と、この時代の移り変わりは良いことなのだと\n信じていました。: I vaguely believed that the changing of this era was a good thing.
貴族制度が終わり、みんなが平等になる。\n深く考えずに、手放しで受け入れてきまし: The nobility system ends, and everyone becomes equal. Without thinking deeply about it, I accepted it wholeheartedly.
でも私は、そんな『貴族』のことを何も知らない。\nそう感じたんです。: But then I realized that I knew nothing about such 'nobles.' That is how I felt.
垣根のない関係は相互理解より生まれ、その第一歩はまずは対話から。\nそう思っても: Relationships without barriers are born from mutual understanding, and the first step is dialogue. Even though I thought that, I understood nothing at its core.
わたくしも『貴族』が何なのかって、\n最初はよくわかってませんでした。: I didn't really understand what a 'noble' was at first, either.
ええ。ですが、リュシーに気付かされたんです。\n弱き者を守る想いこそが、貴族とい: Yes. But Lucy made me realize it. The desire to protect the weak is precisely the sentiment required of those on the privileged side as nobles.
真に正しき貴族は、それを無意識的に持ち合わせているんです。\n例えば、我がカーク: Truly righteous nobles possess that instinctively. For example, the ancestors of my Kirkland family.
その何百年と紡いできた歴史の中で、\n幾度も民を守るために戦ってきました。: Throughout our history woven over hundreds of years, they have fought countless times to protect the people.
わたくしはカークランド家の者としてその弱きを守る一面を\n誇りとしてみなに体現し: As a member of the Kirkland family, I want to embody, show, and pass down that aspect of protecting the weak to everyone with pride.
それが……ドロテア先輩の迷いのなさに繋がるのですね。: So that... connects to your lack of hesitation, Dorothea-senpai.
正確には今回で、迷いをなくすことに繋がるのだと気づいた……\nというのが正しいで: To be precise, it would be more accurate to say I realized during this event that it leads to overcoming hesitation.
なるほど……ふふ、勉強になります。: I see... Fufu, I've learned a lot.
そして思いました。もっとあなたを通じて、いろいろ知りたいと。\n上辺だけではなく: And then I thought: I want to learn more about various things through you. Not just surface-level things, but down to the core.
わたくしの場合貴族の誇りという形になってますが、\n弱きを守りたい気持ちに身分な: In my case, it takes the form of noble pride, but the desire to protect the weak has nothing to do with social status.
根っこの想いが同じであれば、きっと本質的な相互理解だって、\n難しいものでもない: If the underlying feeling is the same, I believe that even genuine mutual understanding won't be difficult.
……これからも、先輩のそばで多くのことを学ばせてほしいです。\n同じ『繋がり』の: ...From now on as well, I hope you will let me learn many things by your side. As companions of the same 'bond.'
そう思ってくれるなら、これ以上の喜びはありません。\nわたくしもクラウディアさん: If you feel that way, there could be no greater joy. I would also like to learn many things from you, Claudia-san.
ドロテアとクラウディアは互いに向き合う。そこには貴族も平民もなく、\nただふたり: Dorothea and Claudia faced each other. There were no nobles or commoners there—only the smiles of two young girls.
